title: oxalis corniculata var. repens
intro: Oxalis corniculata var. repens, commonly known as creeping wood sorrel, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the wood sorrel family (Oxalidaceae). This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which are attributed to its ability to lower blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and act as a diuretic. The health benefits of creeping wood sorrel include its antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which are achieved through its therapeutic actions such as reducing oxidative stress and improving insulin sensitivity. The bioactive constituents of Oxalis corniculata var. repens include oxalic acid, flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
